description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Details of new Vice Chairman for the Valvettithurai Urban Council in Northern Province
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election result for the position of Vice Chairman of the Valvettithurai Urban Council, published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It contains details of the elected official (name and position) and the electoral process, which falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral results and declarations.
